entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I think I need to make a return? I'm not really sure how this works. The website was a bit confusing.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you provide me with the order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see an order for an AeroSafe Helmet from about three months ago. Is that the item you're calling about?
Yes, that's the one! The helmet. I got it for a gift, but the color is all wrong, and I just found it in the closet. The box is still unopened.
I understand. Just to be clear, is there a technical fault with the item, or is it a preference regarding the color?
It's just the color. It's this bright green and I thought it was more of a muted green. I feel so overwhelmed by this. Can't you just help me? I just want to send it back.
Of course, I'm happy to help. Getting the right gear is important, especially for safety equipment. Let me just review the return eligibility for this helmet. One moment.
Alright, I've checked the policy. It looks like your purchase was made 84 days ago, which is well within our standard 90-day return window for this item. I can definitely process this return for you.
Oh, really? That's wonderful! I was so worried I was too late. Thank you so much.

You're very welcome. I've just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to your email. Just print that out, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method.
You've made this so simple. I really appreciate it.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, David.
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
